craft_notes: Sthāyin: single-moment (the shortest instrument). Sanskrit: tanūdeśe śūnyataiva kṣaṇamātraṃ vibhāvayet...nirvikalpasvarūpabhāk → L4 keeps mere-moment + doubled thoughtless. Rows: row 2 (thoughtless twice — music). Close: nature (bhāk — sharing, not attaining). Rejected: 'instant enlightenment' — killed: mere moment envisions, becoming follows; 'share' verb tense — kept noun (nature).

lines: On body-place voidness indeed, mere moment:
l4.sanskrit_cite: tanūdeśe śūnyataiva kṣaṇamātraṃ vibhāvayet | nirvikalpaṃ nirvikalpo nirvikalpasvarūpabhāk

reads_against.argmap: How long is voidness envisioned? → A single moment's envisioning makes one share thoughtless nature.
c1_essence: Mere moment's voidness: sharing thoughtless nature.
